description: This PHP class `LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor` is part of a leave management system within an HRM platform. It processes email notifications related to leave status changes, generating email content replacements and determining recipients based on the leave event.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for processing email notifications related to leave status changes, including generating message replacements and determining recipients based on leave events within the HR management system.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates a set of placeholders and their corresponding values used to compose email templates for a leave status change event.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines the list of email recipients based on the event and specified recipient role, ensuring all leaves belong to the same leave request.

methods.name: verifyLeavesFromOneLeaveRequest
methods.description: Checks that all leave objects in the array are associated with the same leave request ID, throwing an exception if not.
